experiments.title: Cross-Platform Build Portability
experiments.summary: A clean-room build drill from a Linux environment found that ByeByePrice's client build silently depended on a case-insensitive filesystem. Fixed, and now regression-gated by CI on Linux.

experiments.title: Sandbox Continuity for Test Environments
experiments.summary: No single physical device or sandbox instance should be the only place a JasVerse test environment can be understood or rebuilt. Being proven out against ByeByePrice's staging environment.

experiments.title: Mobile-First Product Delivery Model
experiments.summary: A default sequencing principle -- validate on web first, deliver to mobile after real validation and explicit approval -- so that reaching users on the platforms they actually use stops being an easily-forgotten afterthought.

experiments.title: Zero-Budget Engineering Discipline
experiments.summary: A standing practice across JasVerse: prefer free, open, self-hostable, or already-owned capabilities before adopting a paid service, and require a verified material advantage before paying for anything.
